body: Source beamfall/corvint#1536. Open question: when a mutant run is terminated by go test's timeout alarm on a loaded host, is that scored as a kill (false kill) or as unknown?
title: Does a mutant run ended by go test's timeout alarm count as a false kill on a loaded host?
